purpose: Runtime knowledge graph for the post-payment AI voice calling agent that completes KYC and proposal data collection.

evidence.source_note: Derived from the insurer user-field requirement matrix shared for AI calling context. Not yet verified against live insurer adapters.
limitations: Kotak has no numeric insurer_id in the current backend registry (1-9).
United in the matrix maps operationally to UIIC / insurer_id 6 pending string-code confirmation.
NIC and Digit each have multiple backend routes; field requirements here are label-level, not adapter-level.
Collection scripts, consent wording, and recording policy remain TBD.

insurers.label: Digit
insurers.note: Resolve adapter from live case evidence; do not assume from label alone.

insurers.label: NIC
insurers.note: Resolve adapter from live case evidence; do not assume from label alone.

insurers.label: Kotak
insurers.note: Not present in insurer-id-registry 1-9. Keep label only until backend mapping is confirmed.

fields.label: Name
fields.ask_hint: Ask for full name as on ID / proposal.

fields.label: Mobile
fields.ask_hint: Prefer confirming the number already on the case; update only if customer corrects it.

fields.label: DOB
fields.ask_hint: Collect date of birth as day-month-year and repeat it back.

fields.label: Gender
fields.ask_hint: Ask gender as required by the insurer form options.

fields.label: Correspondence address
fields.ask_hint: Collect full correspondence address line by line.

fields.label: Correspondence city/state
fields.ask_hint: HDFC only: capture city and state as shown in UI / form.

fields.label: Permanent address
fields.ask_hint: HDFC only: collect permanent address; confirm if same as correspondence.

fields.label: PAN
fields.ask_hint: Collect PAN letter-by-letter and digit-by-digit; never ask customer to WhatsApp/email PAN.

fields.label: Aadhaar number
fields.ask_hint: ICICI only: collect Aadhaar number carefully; prefer guiding approved digital KYC path when available.

fields.label: Aadhaar images
fields.ask_hint: Never collect images on the call. Guide customer to the approved KYC/WhatsApp/app upload path.

fields.label: GSTIN
fields.ask_hint: Collect GSTIN when the proposal is business/GST applicable.

fields.label: PEP
fields.ask_hint: Ask whether the customer or related party is a Politically Exposed Person; record yes/no as required.

fields.label: Indian
fields.ask_hint: HDFC only: confirm Indian nationality / residency status required by form.

fields.label: Profile photo
fields.ask_hint: HDFC only: never collect photo on the call; guide approved upload path.

fields.label: CIN
fields.ask_hint: AIG only: collect Corporate Identification Number when applicable.

fields.label: Nominee
fields.ask_hint: Collect nominee name and any required relationship/share fields supported by the form.

call_phases.goal: Load case context: proposal_id, insurer_id/label, payment state, KYC/proposal status, already-known fields.
State who is calling, why (post-payment KYC/proposal completion), and get consent to continue.
Compute required field set for insurer minus already-present verified fields.
call_phases.runtime_rule: required = requirement_matrix fields for insurer_id; skip fields marked present+verified in live case payload.

call_phases.goal: Collect voice-allowed missing fields in recommended order; confirm by read-back.
For upload-only fields, send/remind approved digital path; do not accept media on the call.
Do not close from verbal confirmation alone; confirm KYC/proposal progression from live system evidence.
Record privacy-safe disposition, missing fields remaining, upload pending, callback needed, or escalation.

output.unknown_insurer: true when label/id cannot be mapped

insurer_lookup.fallback: matrix label match with mapping_confidence flag

safety_rules: Never invent insurer requirements not present in this graph.
Never ask for OTP on the call.
Never ask customer to send Aadhaar/PAN/profile images over general WhatsApp/email/chat unless that channel is the approved KYC path for the case.
Never store raw Aadhaar/PAN/full address payloads in wiki notes, training dumps, or unrestricted logs.
Never mark KYC/proposal complete from verbal confirmation alone.
If insurer is Kotak or otherwise unmapped, collect only universal fields after stating mapping is incomplete, then escalate for confirmed field list.
If live case evidence conflicts with this matrix, prefer live owning-system evidence and flag the conflict.
